n: Higa Distillery — ZANPA Factory Shop (比嘉酒造 ZANPAファクトリーショップ)
w: Yomitan distillery behind Zanpa, one of Okinawa's best-known awamori brands, named for the waves breaking on nearby Cape Zanpa. The light Zanpa White (25°) was created by the second-generation owner to win over drinkers new to awamori; a factory shop opened on the grounds in 2018.

dish: Taco rice — eight house variations incl. ABC (avocado-bacon-cheese) taco rice
n: RuLer's TACORiCE Ginowan Honten (ルーラーズタコライス 宜野湾本店)
w: A taco-rice specialist whose Ginowan flagship serves eight original recipes — classic cheese, BBQ, Caesar, teriyaki and the avocado-bacon-cheese ABC — in sizes up to extra-large, with about ten extra toppings. Tabirai lists it among Okinawa's nine top taco-rice shops.

dish: Jumbo cheeseburger (ジャンボチーズバーガー)
n: Rotary Drive-In, Michi-no-Eki Kadena (ロータリードライブイン)
w: Opened in 1975 as a restaurant with a take-out window, on the site where Michi-no-Eki Kadena stands now. Its American-style menu was a rarity that won over locals and visitors. The founders' daughter took over in 2016; the dining room closed after the renovation and the pandemic, and it now runs as a take-out counter on the roadside station's ground floor, famous for its jumbo cheeseburger.

dish: Apple pie and American-style cakes & pastries
n: Jimmy's Ōyama (ジミー 大山店)
w: The first shop of Jimmy's, the American-style bakery, deli and import grocery founded in 1956 and loved by Okinawans ever since. Its fresh-baked pies, apple pie above all, cream puffs and other pastries are the draw, alongside imported groceries, wine and awamori.

dish: Okinawa zenzai (shaved ice over sweet kintoki beans); also bonito-dashi Okinawa soba and yellow katsu curry
n: Uehara Zenzai, Moromizato (上原ぜんざい)
w: A neighbourhood shokudō opened in 2000 by Matayoshi Sueko, who trained at the venerable Aragaki Zenzai-ya in Motobu; Ryukyu Shimpo profiled it at 20 years. The Okinawa zenzai is the name on the door, but OTV's Okitive also singles out its old-style yellow curry-powder katsu curry, and the Okinawa soba is made with bonito dashi.

dish: Honejiru (pork-bone soup, 骨汁) and gōyā champurū
n: Gaburi Shokudō, Ginowan Yui Marché (がぶり食堂)
address: Ginowan Yui Marché, Ōyama, Ginowan, Okinawa
w: A locals' shokudō inside the Ginowan Yui Marché farm market in Ōyama. Its signature honejiru is a soup made from the pork bones left over from boiling Okinawa-soba stock, with the meat falling off the bone; Okinawa Times' driver-lunch column came for it, and Ginowan's tourism site recommends it alongside the gōyā champurū.

dish: Kuwachii soba (rich pork-bone Okinawa soba with soft-bone sōki) and chicken nanban
n: Kuwachii Shokudō Aozora, Kitanakagusuku (くわっちぃ食堂 青空 北中城店)
address: 1359-1 Adaniya, Kitanakagusuku, Okinawa (inside Hotel Southern Village)
w: A cheap-and-filling village shokudō in Hotel Southern Village, Adaniya. OTV's Okitive put it at No. 1 in a 2025 top-30 Okinawa-soba ranking for its rich pork-bone soba, and its chicken nanban is the other order everyone makes; the village tourism portal lists it among Kitanakagusuku's places to eat.
